verdict.rationale: Plaid documents an official 'Dashboard MCP server' hosted by Plaid providing Production diagnostics and analytics tools (debugging Items, Link conversion data, usage metrics), confirmed by both docs and a probe hit. However, this MCP server is scoped only to dashboard/analytics functions rather than full API/product access (Auth, Transactions, Identity, etc.), so an agent cannot use it to perform general Plaid operations via MCP. Missing for 10: MCP coverage of core Plaid API functionality (Auth, Transactions, Payments) and independent/community corroboration of real-world MCP usage.
